flow_ref: User story (not in any OCMS flow deck)
code_summary: ocmsadminprivateapi framework/workflows/notification_sms_email/{jobs/NotificationSmsEmailJob,helpers/NotificationSmsEmailHelper} (DN2/DR3 reminder query, exclusion list, DataHive contact refresh, combineNotices, batch SMS), framework/schedulers/NotificationJobsScheduler, utilities/smsutility/SmsUtil, framework/workflows/agencies/toppan/upload/helpers/ToppanUploadHelper (stage DN2 -> DR3), framework/workflows/agencies/mha/{upload,download} (particulars check), utilities/suspension_helpers/SuspensionBaseHelper, framework/workflows/datahiveuenfin/services/DataHiveUenFinService. ocmsadminapi operational/cronproxy/CronProxyService (manual trigger). ocmsadminui, ocmseserviceapi, ocmseserviceui, thirdpartyapi: no driver reminder code
note: Status 'Demo paid (50% of 75%)'; demo_remark: Vault & SMS Code Split (SMS and Vault permission for the App Service: cannot verify from repo). There is no flow deck, so 'Sesuai' means the code follows the story text. The SMS sending code is the same as OCMS12.9 (RD2) and OCMS11.4 (RD1), with last stage DN2 and template DN2_SMS_INDIVIDUAL[_COMBINED]: batch to Postman2 via APIM, at most 1000 per batch, notices merged per ID + stage + due date. Gaps: (1) cron.notification.enabled=false in dev/UAT/PROD; (2) in PROD sms.enable=false with no sms.allowedSources, so SmsUtil rejects the batch; (3) the number refresh from DataHive is off (cron.enareminder.datahive=false); (4) merging does not cross different due dates and there is no de-duplication by number; (5) the DN2 template content is in the DB. loadAllExcludedIds is fail-open when the read fails. 'DOS' does not appear in the code; DOS = DataHive/LTA cannot be confirmed from the repo. Tickets used: OCMS-DF-2026-180 (Closed; waiting for the eNotification cron to activate).
recommendation: Claim partially (60%). The SMS code for DN2 exists and the opt-out / valid number filtering is right, but the eNotification job and SMS sending are switched off in the properties, the DOS refresh is off, and the template content is not verifiable. Ask for evidence that the eNotification cron is active and a DN2 SMS was sent in PRD, the DN2 template, and SMS permission for the App Service.

steps.step: OCMS gets the latest mobile number of the individual driver from DOS (DataHive)
steps.detail: The job calls batchPreloadContactInfo and then refreshContactInfo per record (NotificationSmsEmailJob.java:185-187). Individuals are checked against DataHive Singpass through refreshIndividualContactInfo (NotificationSmsEmailHelper.java:2710-2716), but the whole refresh only runs when cron.enareminder.datahive = true (NotificationSmsEmailHelper.java:92-93, 2325-2332, 2468-2477) and the value is false in dev, UAT and PROD (cron-schedules-prod.properties:48), so only the number already stored on the record is used. The word 'DOS' does not appear in the code; DOS = DataHive/LTA cannot be confirmed from the repo. Vault/DataHive access from the App Service: cannot verify from repo. Same fit as the contact-check steps in OCMS12.8, OCMS12.9 and OCMS12.18.

steps.step: OCMS identifies unique individual drivers per batch so each driver gets one SMS
steps.detail: combineNotices merges notices by recipient key I_<ID> + stage + due date, sums amount_payable and fills combinedNotices (NotificationSmsEmailHelper.java:2151-2178, 2180-2219; getRecipientKey 2230-2250; called at NotificationSmsEmailJob.java:191), so one driver's DN2 notices with the same due date become one SMS (template *_COMBINED). Partial because the key contains the due date: one driver with notices on different due dates gets more than one SMS. There is no de-duplication by phone number: two different IDs with the same number each get an SMS (comment at NotificationSmsEmailJob.java:249, 'no deduplication by phone'). Same fit as OCMS12.9.

steps.step: The SMS lists the outstanding notice(s) and refers to the 2nd letter, for a fine that is due soon
steps.detail: For reminders, nextProcessingStage is set to the last stage (DN2) (NotificationSmsEmailJob.java:174-179), so determineTemplateName produces DN2_SMS_INDIVIDUAL or DN2_SMS_INDIVIDUAL_COMBINED (NotificationSmsEmailHelper.java:459-476). The template is read from the DB and filled with noticeNo, combinedNotices, noticeCount, amountPayable, paymentDueDate, vehicleNo (NotificationSmsEmailHelper.java:296-309, 410-437); when the template is missing, the SMS is skipped with an error log (lines 307-309). Only notices due within ENOTEDAYS days are selected (NotificationSmsEmailHelper.java:1107-1118), matching 'due soon', and the due date in the SMS is calculated the same as in the letter (OCMS-DF-2026-180). Partial because the template text, whether it mentions the 2nd letter, and the ENOTEDAYS value are in the DB, not in the repo: cannot verify from repo.

steps.step: OCMS sends the SMS reminder/notification to the individual driver in a batch job
steps.detail: The job sends through sendBatchSms (Postman2 via APIM, at most 1000 per batch, status polling, source ENOTIFICATION; NotificationSmsEmailHelper.java:1527-1535, 1612; application-prod.properties:36-45) when notification.sms.enabled=true (application.properties:176; NotificationSmsEmailJob.java:289-291). Partial because (1) the eNotification scheduler skips execution when cron.notification.enabled=false (NotificationJobsScheduler.java:30-31, 48-52) and the value is false in dev, UAT and PROD (cron-schedules-prod.properties:236); it only runs through the manual trigger POST /notification-sms-email/execute (CronProxyService.java:203); (2) in PROD sms.enable=false with no sms.allowedSources (application-prod.properties:87), so SmsUtil rejects the batch with status disabled (SmsUtil.java:401-409); in dev and UAT sms.enable=false but sms.allowedSources=ENOTIFICATION lets it through (application-dev.properties:85, application-uat.properties:82). The running server values, SMS permission for the App Service and the Postman2 gateway: cannot verify from repo. Ticket OCMS-DF-2026-180 (Closed) carries the remark 'Awaiting eNotification cron to activate'.

steps.step: Only individual drivers with a valid number who have not opted out get an SMS
steps.detail: The reminder query drops IDs found in ocms_enotification_exclusion_list (NotificationSmsEmailHelper.java:1131-1134) and the job checks again against the preloaded list before the SMS batch is prepared: IDs on the exclusion list are skipped and for reminders the stage is not changed, the notice stays on the letter track (NotificationSmsEmailJob.java:226-232); passport holders cannot be eNotified and are skipped (NotificationSmsEmailJob.java:237-243). The content of the exclusion list is DB data: cannot verify from repo. One thing to watch: loadAllExcludedIds returns an empty set when the read fails (fail-open, NotificationSmsEmailHelper.java:1212-1214), so on a read error the opt-out is not enforced at the job gate. Same fit as the exclusion step in OCMS12.8. Records without phoneNo are skipped (NotificationSmsEmailHelper.java:2283-2288; NotificationSmsEmailJob.java:254-266) and companies do not enter the SMS batch (NotificationSmsEmailJob.java:274-277).
